## Description

Buy when RSI crosses below a low threshold and recovers, or sell/exit when RSI reaches an upper threshold.

## Where it may fit

Range-bound markets with recurring reversion; risky during strong one-way trends.

## Vehicles

Stocks, liquid ETFs, FX, futures and crypto.

## Required data

OHLC/close history, RSI window, volume/liquidity and costs.

## Caveats

Thresholds are not universal; a trend/regime filter and clear exits are often needed.
